description: Add one user-supplied fact to the kit so the article can cite it: one plain line of text (at most 200 characters), optional source_url, attribution and priority (normal or must_use). A source_url is fetched now and cited only when its page states the fact (source_url_cited). Duplicates, URLs the brand source policy or blocked hosts refuse, and URL-less facts in a regulated workspace are 422s. Returns the kit and the new claim_id (user:k-...); kit facts survive kit rebuilds. Send the kit_revision just read as expected_kit_revision. Never send Idempotency-Key.

body.description:
Add one supplied fact to the kit (request). Same rules as brief facts;
a duplicate of a fact already on the kit is a 422.
